errors.relay_login_challenge: Too many failed sign-ins through Meshloom Remote from this network. Opening the check page…
errors.auth_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {{retry_after}} seconds.
errors.request_timeout: This request took too long to arrive. Try again.
errors.server_busy: Meshloom is busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.request_too_large: This request is too large for Meshloom.
errors.auth_host_rejected: Request refused: this address is not one this instance answers to.
errors.auth_last_admin: This is the last administrator: keep at least one.
errors.auth_no_session: Signing in did not open a session. Reload the page and try again.
errors.auth_https_required: HTTPS is required from the internet: open Meshloom with its https:// address (your reverse proxy, Tailscale or Meshloom Remote).
errors.auth_https_would_lock_out: A public address would block your current http:// connection. Open Meshloom over https:// or from the local network first.

auth.sessionLoadFailed: Meshloom could not reach the server.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to use this Meshloom.
login.remember: Keep me signed in on this device
login.rememberHint: Unchecked, you are signed out when you close the browser, and after 12 hours without activity.
login.insecureContext: Unencrypted connection (HTTP): use your password only on a network you trust.

relogin.title: Session ended
relogin.body: Your session has ended. Sign in again to carry on where you were.

setup.title: Create the administrator account
setup.description: This Meshloom has no account yet. The one you create here can manage everything.
setup.passwordPolicy: At least {{min_length}} characters, different from the user name. A few words in a row make a good password.

localOnly.title: Open Meshloom on your local network
localOnly.description: The administrator account is created from the local network. Open Meshloom from a phone or computer on the same network as this machine.

userMenu.ingressNote: Home Assistant signs you in: there is no Meshloom session to end.
userMenu.stillSignedInNote: This device stays signed in: the local network is set to login-free (Settings → Connection → Local network).
